title: त्रिसप्तत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: After four years on the mountain, Bhima, Arjuna and the twins urge Yudhishthira to think of regaining the kingdom. They take leave of the place and, guided by Arshtishena and carried by Ghatotkacha, descend from the mountain.
summary.kn: ಪರ್ವತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಲ್ಕು ವರ್ಷ ಕಳೆದ ಮೇಲೆ ಭೀಮ, ಅರ್ಜುನ, ಅವಳಿಗಳು ರಾಜ್ಯ ಮರಳಿಪಡೆಯುವ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯೋಚಿಸೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಾಯಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆ ಸ್ಥಳದಿಂದ ಬೀಳ್ಕೊಂಡು ಆರ್ಷ್ಟಿಷೇಣನ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನದಲ್ಲಿ, ಘಟೋತ್ಕಚನು ಹೊತ್ತು, ಪರ್ವತದಿಂದ ಇಳಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पर्वत पर चार वर्ष बिताने के बाद भीम, अर्जुन और जुड़वाँ भाई युधिष्ठिर से राज्य वापस पाने का विचार करने का आग्रह करते हैं। वे उस स्थान से विदा लेकर आर्ष्टिषेण के मार्गदर्शन में और घटोत्कच की सहायता से पर्वत से उतरते हैं।
summary.te: పర్వతంపై నాలుగేళ్లు గడిపిన తర్వాత భీముడు, అర్జునుడు, కవలలు రాజ్యాన్ని తిరిగి పొందడం గురించి ఆలోచించమని యుధిష్ఠిరుని కోరతారు. ఆ ప్రదేశం వద్ద సెలవు తీసుకొని ఆర్ష్టిషేణుని మార్గదర్శనంలో, ఘటోత్కచుడు మోయగా పర్వతం దిగుతారు.
summary.ta: மலையில் நான்கு ஆண்டுகள் கழித்தபின் பீமன், அர்ஜுனன், இரட்டையர் அரசை மீட்பது பற்றிச் சிந்திக்குமாறு யுதிஷ்டிரரை வற்புறுத்துகிறார்கள். அவ்விடத்திடம் விடைபெற்று, ஆர்ஷ்டிஷேணரின் வழிகாட்டலுடனும் கடோத்கசன் சுமந்தும் மலையிலிருந்து இறங்குகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: ഗന്ധമാദനത്തിൽ നാലു വർഷം കഴിഞ്ഞശേഷം ഭീമനും അർജുനനും ഇരട്ടകളും രാജ്യം വീണ്ടെടുക്കാൻ ചിന്തിക്കണമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരനോട് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നു. അവർ ആ സ്ഥലത്തോട് യാത്ര പറഞ്ഞ്, അർഷ്ടിഷേണന്റെ വഴികാട്ടലോടെയും ഘടോത്കചന്റെ ചുമലിലേറിയും പർവതത്തിൽനിന്ന് ഇറങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.173; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
तस्मिन्कृतास्त्रे रथिनां प्रधाने
प्रत्यागते भवनाद्वृत्रहन्तुः ।
अतः परं किमकुर्वन्त पार्थाः
समेत्य शूरेण धनंजयेन ॥

meaning.en: When that foremost of charioteers, master of the weapons, had come back from the palace of the slayer of Vritra, what did the Parthas do next, having met the heroic Dhananjaya?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
वनेषु तेष्वेव तु ते नरेन्द्राः
सहार्जुनेनेन्द्रसमेन वीराः ।
तस्मिंश्च शैलप्रवरे सुरम्ये
धनेश्वराक्रीडगता विजह्रुः ॥

meaning.en: Those royal heroes, with Arjuna who was equal to Indra, lived on in those same forests and roamed on that excellent, lovely mountain, the pleasure-ground of the lord of wealth.

verses.text:
वेश्मानि तान्यप्रतिमानि पश्य-
न्क्रीडाश्च नानाद्रुमसंनिकर्षाः ।
चचार धन्वी बहुधा नरेन्द्रः
सोऽस्त्रेषु यत्तः सततं किरीटी ॥

meaning.en: Looking at those matchless dwellings and the pleasure gardens near many kinds of trees, the royal archer Arjuna, wearer of the diadem, kept moving about in various ways, always intent on his weapons.

verses.text:
अवाप्य वासं नरदेवपुत्राः
प्रसादजं वैश्रवणस्य राज्ञः ।
न प्राणिनां ते स्पृहयन्ति राज-
ञ्शिवश्च कालः स बभूव तेषाम् ॥

meaning.en: Having gained a dwelling there by the grace of King Vaishravana, the sons of kings had no longing for other creatures, and that time was a happy one for them.

verses.text:
समेत्य पार्थेन यथैकरात्र-
मूषुः समास्तत्र तदा चतस्रः ।
पूर्वाश्च षट्ता दश पाण्डवानां
शिवा बभूवुर्वसतां वनेषु ॥

meaning.en: Having met Partha, they stayed there four years as if for a single night; and the earlier six years the Pandavas had spent in the forests had also been happy.

verses.text:
ततोऽब्रवीद्वायुसुतस्तरस्वी
जिष्णुश्च राजानमुपोपविश्य ।
यमौ च वीरौ सुरराजकल्पा-
वेकान्तमास्थाय हितं प्रियं च ॥

meaning.en: Then the swift son of the Wind god and Jishnu sat near the king, and with the two heroic twins, who were like kings of the gods, they spoke in private what was good and dear.

verses.text:
तव प्रतिज्ञां कुरुराज सत्यां
चिकीर्षमाणास्त्वदनु प्रियं च ।
ततोऽनुगच्छाम वनान्यपास्य
सुयोधनं सानुचरं निहन्तुम् ॥

meaning.en: "King of the Kurus, wishing to make your vow true and to please you, we followed you into the forests, leaving Duryodhana aside, in order to kill him with his followers.

verses.text:
एकादशं वर्षमिदं वसामः
सुयोधनेनात्तसुखाः सुखार्हाः ।
तं वञ्चयित्वाधमबुद्धिशील-
मज्ञातवासं सुखमाप्नुयामः ॥

meaning.en: This is the eleventh year we are living, with the comforts we deserve taken away by Duryodhana. If we deceive him, whose mind and conduct are low, we may then live in comfort in concealment.

verses.text:
तवाज्ञया पार्थिव निर्विशङ्का
विहाय मानं विचरन्वनानि ।
समीपवासेन विलोभितास्ते
ज्ञास्यन्ति नास्मानपकृष्टदेशान् ॥

meaning.en: At your command, O king, without fear, putting aside pride and roaming the forests, they, tempted by our living nearby, will not know us once we are in a remote place.

verses.text:
संवत्सरं तं तु विहृत्य गूढं
नराधमं तं सुखमुद्धरेम ।
निर्यात्य वैरं सफलं सपुष्पं
तस्मै नरेन्द्राधमपूरुषाय ॥

meaning.en: Having spent that year hidden, we will easily uproot that lowest of men, repaying our enmity, with flowers and fruit, on that lowest of royal creatures.

verses.text:
सुयोधनायानुचरैर्वृताय
ततो महीमाहर धर्मराज ।
स्वर्गोपमं शैलमिमं चरद्भिः
शक्यो विहन्तुं नरदेव शोकः ॥

meaning.en: Then, king of dharma, take back the earth from Duryodhana and his followers. Grief can be driven out for us as we wander on this mountain that is like heaven.

verses.text:
कीर्तिश्च ते भारत पुण्यगन्धा
नश्येत लोकेषु चराचरेषु ।
तत्प्राप्य राज्यं कुरुपुंगवानां
शक्यं महत्प्राप्तमथ क्रियाश्च ॥

meaning.en: Your fame, Bharata, with its holy fragrance, may perish among the moving and unmoving worlds. By winning the kingdom of the foremost Kurus, great gains and rites can be achieved.

verses.text:
इदं तु शक्यं सततं नरेन्द्र
प्राप्तुं त्वया यल्लभसे कुबेरात् ।
कुरुष्व बुद्धिं द्विषतां वधाय
कृतागसां भारत निग्रहे च ॥

meaning.en: But what you obtain from Kubera can be had always, lord of men. So set your mind on killing your enemies and punishing those who wronged you, Bharata.

verses.text:
तेजस्तवोग्रं न सहेत राज-
न्समेत्य साक्षादपि वज्रपाणिः ।
न हि व्यथां जातु करिष्यतस्तौ
समेत्य देवैरपि धर्मराज ॥

meaning.en: O king, even the wielder of the thunderbolt, meeting your fierce energy face to face, would not endure it. Those two, Bhima and Arjuna, will never suffer distress even meeting the gods, king of dharma.

verses.text:
त्वदर्थसिद्ध्यर्थमभिप्रवृत्तौ
सुपर्णकेतुश्च शिनेश्च नप्ता ।
यथैव कृष्णोऽप्रतिमो बलेन
तथैव राजन्स शिनिप्रवीरः ॥

meaning.en: Krishna, whose banner bears Garuda, and the grandson of Shini are set on the success of your aim. As Krishna is matchless in strength, so is that hero of the Shinis, O king.

verses.text:
तवार्थसिद्ध्यर्थमभिप्रवृत्तौ
यथैव कृष्णः सह यादवैस्तैः ।
तथैव चावां नरदेववर्य
यमौ च वीरौ कृतिनौ प्रयोगे ।
त्वदर्थयोगप्रभवप्रधानाः
समं करिष्याम परान्समेत्य ॥

meaning.en: As Krishna with those Yadavas is set on achieving your aim, so are we two, best of kings, and the heroic twins too, skilled in their craft. With you as our chief, from whom our undertaking springs, we shall meet our enemies and deal with them alike."

verses.text:
ततस्तदाज्ञाय मतं महात्मा
तेषां स धर्मस्य सुतो वरिष्ठः ।
प्रदक्षिणं वैश्रवणाधिवासं
चकार धर्मार्थविदुत्तमौजः ॥

meaning.en: Then the great-souled son of Dharma, the best, understanding their opinion, of supreme vigor and knowing dharma and artha, circled Vaishravana's abode keeping it to his right.

verses.text:
आमन्त्र्य वेश्मानि नदीः सरांसि
सर्वाणि रक्षांसि च धर्मराजः ।
यथागतं मार्गमवेक्षमाणः
पुनर्गिरिं चैव निरीक्षमाणः ॥

meaning.en: The king of dharma took leave of the houses, rivers, lakes and all the rakshasas, looking back along the road by which they had come and gazing again at the mountain.

verses.text:
समाप्तकर्मा सहितः सुहृद्भि-
र्जित्वा सपत्नान्प्रतिलभ्य राज्यम् ।
शैलेन्द्र भूयस्तपसे धृतात्मा
द्रष्टा तवास्मीति मतिं चकार ॥

meaning.en: Having completed his task, he resolved: "With my friends, after conquering my rivals and recovering my kingdom, I will, with a steady mind, come again to see you, lord of mountains, for austerity."

verses.text:
वृतः स सर्वैरनुजैर्द्विजैश्च
तेनैव मार्गेण पतिः कुरूणाम् ।
उवाह चैनान्सगणांस्तथैव
घटोत्कचः पर्वतनिर्झरेषु ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by all his younger brothers and the brahmins, the lord of the Kurus went by that same road, and Ghatotkacha carried them with their companions over the mountain streams.

verses.text:
तान्प्रस्थितान्प्रीतिमना महर्षिः
पितेव पुत्राननुशिष्य सर्वान् ।
स लोमशः प्रीतमना जगाम
दिवौकसां पुण्यतमं निवासम् ॥

meaning.en: As they departed, the great sage Lomasha, happy, instructed them all like a father his sons, and then went contentedly to the most holy abode of the heaven-dwellers.

verses.text:
तेनानुशिष्टार्ष्टिषेणेन चैव
तीर्थानि रम्याणि तपोवनानि ।
महान्ति चान्यानि सरांसि पार्थाः
संपश्यमानाः प्रययुर्नराग्र्याः ॥

meaning.en: Instructed by him and by Arshtishena, the Parthas, best of men, went on, seeing lovely sacred fords, hermitages and other great lakes.
